name: Story hill with words
what: A thick glowing line in the shape of a hill draws itself while a camera flies along it: three words pop onto the line as the camera reaches them (the climb, the top, the way down), then it whips out to show the whole hill with a line of text popping in under it.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f4 the foot of the hill's line holds, f5-f20 it draws on faster and faster; the camera (about 1.7x) pans along it: f14-f23 up and over, hold on the top f24-f31, f32-f41 a fast whip (ghost copies) to the far side, hold f42-f52, f53-f66 whips out to the whole hill and holds to f78; the words pop onto the line at f5, f20 and f38 and the line under the hill at f55 (0.45x to full size in 4-5 frames, a sideways blur that clears)

tracks.name: line draws on
tracks.what: the line is there up to a point (f0-f4), then draws on faster and faster off the frame

tracks.name: camera pan up and over
tracks.what: from the climb to the top of the hill

tracks.name: camera whip to the far side
tracks.what: a fast pan down the other side with ghost copies at its fastest (f37)

tracks.name: camera whip out
tracks.what: it pulls back to the whole hill

tracks.name: word pops
tracks.what: each word grows from 0.45x to full size with a blur that clears, on the line's edge (f5, f20, f38); the line under the hill the same at f55
